text:
priya: Heads-up  new constraint from infra + legal this morning. We need a final scope decision for MVP by EOD or we slip the milestone. Main ask: keep low-latency chat & embeddings. Options: (A) MVP-lite: drop per-tenant routing & admin analytics; (B) MVP-pilot: keep tenant routing behind strict pilot only with signed DPA, drop analytics. Legal prefers B for named pilots. Thoughts?

ben: From engineering POV, tenant routing adds routing table state + auth handshake changes. Pilot mode is doable but needs an isolation shim and a rollback path. ETA for pilot implementation: ~3 days. Lite path = ~1 day.

zara: Also consider model switches: if we include quantized LLM support in MVP, we save cost but add a testing surface that correlates with tenant routing complexity. I'd prefer to decouple: ship quantized models in v1 to reduce variables now.

kevin: Infra note: pilot routing requires a dedicated gateway pool + per-tenant KV. Ops cost +2 gateway instances during peak. If we do pilot, we need a billing hook to cover reserved capacity for pilot tenants.

morgan: Product ops: customers who asked for routing are enterprise beta partners. If we pick Lite, we should offer an explicit pilot program that includes manual routing support for up to 2 tenants. That reduces engineering scope but keeps sales pipeline happy.

evan: Legal: we can do limited pilots under existing AUP, but for anything that touches cross-tenant data boundaries we need DPA signed and a short addendum. So pilot path requires sign-off before we enable feature-flag for any tenant.

priya: Proposal: go with a hybrid "MVP-fast" decision: lock scope to chat + embeddings + basic moderation + billing hooks. Defer admin analytics and quantized model support to v1. For tenant routing: enable a manual pilot (ops-assisted) for up to 2 named tenants only; engineering will not include automated per-tenant routing in the initial rollout. This keeps release date and reduces risk.

ben: I can implement a manual routing shim and an ops runbook for pilot activation (ETA 24h). Will add a feature-flag stub to make future autopilot easier.

zara: Good. We'll push quantized support to the v1 checklist and add model-sanity tests to the prelaunch evals.

kevin: I'll reserve the gateway pool and write the scaling playbook. Ops monitoring: automatic alert if mem > 75% or p95 > 250ms.

morgan: I'll update release notes and handbook: explain deferred items, pilot process, ETA for v1 (target: 3 sprints post-launch).

evan: I'll draft the pilot addendum and a one-page DPA checklist for sales to collect signatures before pilot enablement.

launch-bot: deploy planned: branch `release/2026-08-01-mvp` -> staging at 2026-07-30 11:00 UTC.

priya: Action recap: 1) @ben manual routing shim + runbook (24h), 2) @kevin reserve gateways + alerts, 3) @morgan docs + release notes, 4) @evan pilot addendum. Locking scope to MVP-fast now unless objections.

ben: PR opened for shim: github.com/redwood/release/pull/1123. Tests & QA notes added.

priya: Locking scope: core chat + embeddings + moderation + billing hooks. Tenant routing = ops-assisted pilot for named tenants only. Quantized model support and admin analytics deferred to v1. Posting to handbook and notifying partners.
